description: Fourth lane generation (#669): frozen LongMemEval_S retrieval parity, retrieval only, no LLM anywhere, re-executing every row of longmemeval-s-retrieval-parity-v2 at a runtime revision in the declared transition to Runtime Baseline v3 (ranking policy 3.2.0; semantic vector route reachable, default off). The Agent Memory control runs the shipped default (semantic route off, budget 50) and must reproduce every scored metric of the -v2 control exactly; this lane is acceptance evidence reports/runtime/baseline-v3-declaration.json names for the successor publication. A measured comparator row (agent_memory_semantic) runs the same facade with semantic_retrieval=required under the pinned local representation; it is evidence for #673, not the publication control. Hindsight stays deferred.
freeze_rationale: the -v2 lane is accepted and its control executed the declared transition to Runtime Baseline v2; the #669 tranche (PR #707) changed ranking policy to 3.2.0 (semantic_vector as an ordering-subordinate route) and opened a declared transition to v3, so the executing runtime is new and needs a new lane id (change_rule)

the control declares no semantic_retrieval (the runner and importer read absence as off, the shipped default); every scored metric must equal the accepted -v2 control's exactly (headline, knowledge_update_headline and latest_gold_ranked_first on both planes; timing and governance counters excluded); any difference blocks v3 publication

the agent_memory_semantic row is pre-registered before any score: turn recall_all@50 and session recall_all@5/@10 equal the control's or differ only by tie reordering; session recall_all@30/@50 may rise because semantic-only candidates can reach ranks 34-50 on the session plane; 'move' means a strict increase on the same 419 scored questions

#669's original gate (turn recall_all@50 and session recall_all@5 must move) is structurally unattainable under policy 3.2.0: a semantic-only candidate ranks after every lexical candidate, and the -v2 control admits at least 113 lexical candidates per turn question and at least 33 per session question; the gate transfers to #673 (fusion) with this row's route diagnostics
the baseline and comparator rows are re-executed unchanged so every row shares one runner blob and one executing posture; accepted -v2 rows are never copied forward

harness.package: reference/run_longmemeval.py (repository-owned replica of the upstream retrieval evaluator at the pinned revision; retrieval only, the upstream model-judged QA evaluator is never run). source_blobs bind the upstream files the replica reproduces (src/retrieval/*) and the repository files that execute the lane (reference/*); the workflow refuses to run if a reference/* blob differs.
harness.license_note: upstream code MIT (LICENSE blob below); the cleaned dataset is obtained by the operator from the Hugging Face hub at the recorded revision and is never redistributed by this repository

dataset.input_digest_rule: sha256 over the raw bytes of longmemeval_s_cleaned.json (277,383,467 bytes at hub revision 98d7416c); the runner streams and hashes every byte on each pass and refuses if any pass disagrees; the workflow also checks the download against this digest before the run
notes: document_count is the session plane: 23,867 haystack sessions summed over the 500 questions (max 62 per question); the turn plane indexes 122,416 user turns (max 305 per question). Each question is its own isolated corpus exactly as upstream process_item_flat_index builds a flat index per question; there is no shared corpus across questions.

query_partition is by upstream question_type. Scoring denominators exclude the 30 abstention questions (_abs in question_id) and the 51 questions with no user-side has_answer target, leaving 419 scored questions in both planes; the exclusions are upstream rules replicated byte for byte.
13 questions repeat a haystack session id; the replica indexes each repetition as its own corpus item under the same id, as upstream does, and refuses repeats whose content differs.
the hub serves the fixture with x-linked-etag equal to its sha256, so the digest check is also a check that the hub object is unchanged

selection.selection_method: all 500 questions in source order; no --max-questions, no --subset-size; input.selection.question_ids_sha256 must equal 7d738ae585fd4014c9d231088ff824864fded501adc07b0e08c2b97a28210c03

budget.retrieval_k_rule: every backend returns one ranking per question; rankings are scored at k in {1, 3, 5, 10, 30, 50} and the top 50 is reported. The lexical baseline returns every overlapping item; the Agent Memory control declares budget=50 on every recall (contract 1.4.0) and ranks the facade's `returned` prefix of its admitted facts, the deepest scored k, so bounding there cannot change any scored metric; the Mem0 row returns top_k=50. No answer-generation context budget exists.
forbidden_overrides: --max-questions and --subset-size must be unset (subset_size 0 in the workflow); a bounded run is a smoke, never an acceptable row
--agent-memory-temporal-metadata must remain none and --agent-memory-ranking-variant must remain default (the frozen comparability posture: only question and item text reach Agent Memory)
no backend may read answer, answer_session_ids, has_answer, question_type, question_date or haystack_dates of a question; backends receive the question text and the corpus items {id, text, date} only
the Mem0 row may not use infer=True, a graph store, a reranker, the fastembed extra or the spaCy extra; mem0.__version__ must equal 2.2.1
--agent-memory-semantic-retrieval only on agent_memory_semantic (required); every other row runs it off; auto is refused by the runner

gold_identity.rule: per question, exactly upstream: session plane gold = haystack session ids containing 'answer' (relabelled noans when no user turn in that session carries has_answer); turn plane gold = user turns of those sessions with has_answer (others relabelled noans); recall_all/recall_any/ndcg_any computed by the replica of eval_utils.py; turn rankings are also collapsed to distinct sessions for the turn-to-session view
resolution_paths: item id returned verbatim by the backend (lexical_overlap, no_memory)
admitted fact uuid mapped to the item id through a per-question sidecar that never enters memory text (agent_memory)
metadata.doc_id read back from each Mem0 search result; results without doc_id are counted as unmapped and dropped (mem0_explicit)
gold_identity.leakage_rule: item ids are opaque handles supplied beside the text, never inside it; Agent Memory receives opaque target references and the item text, Mem0 receives the item text as a single user message with the id only in metadata; gold, answers, has_answer flags and question types never reach any backend; out-of-corpus ids in a ranking are counted and score as misses

evaluator.scorer: reference/run_longmemeval.py @ blob eaa7ca96bc68cec23eab904ca9fed76db82faafc: evaluate_retrieval / evaluate_retrieval_turn2session / _ndcg replicate src/retrieval/eval_utils.py @ blob 9c43a835e7c41aff0eb3272c448f5cbe76bbbd45 and the exclusion and averaging rules of src/retrieval/run_retrieval.py @ blob 48e615df943a329801c3703edf4f83dc0a18fe17
headline_metrics: session recall_all@5, ndcg_any@5, recall_all@10, ndcg_any@10 over 419 scored questions
turn recall_all@5, ndcg_any@5, recall_all@10, ndcg_any@10, recall_all@50, ndcg_any@50 over 419 scored questions
knowledge-update slice of the same metrics (72 scored questions)
latest_gold_ranked_first (profile-local currentness diagnostic, not an upstream metric)
evaluator.integrity_check: the integration's declared negative controls (missing_gold, irrelevant_ahead, rank_below_cutoff, stale_over_current, suppressed_abstention, identity_mapping_corruption, cross_scope_injection) run through reference/run_benchmark_integrity_mutants.py and must all be detected, with irrelevant_at_rank_one recorded as the known upstream DCG insensitivity, before any row of this lane is accepted

execution.timeout: none in the runner; the workflow job timeout (240 min) bounds each (row, plane) dispatch
execution.failure_handling: a question-level exception is recorded as runtime_error and the question scores as a miss with an empty ranking; ingestion refusals (Agent Memory not_committed, Mem0 add without an ADD event) are counted per question, never raised; an input digest that differs between streaming passes aborts the run; a missing credential or a failed posture check is a blocked execution, never a score

environment.dispatch_unit: one workflow dispatch per (row, plane) with lane_id longmemeval-s-retrieval-parity-v3: backend in {agent_memory, agent_memory_semantic, lexical_overlap, mem0_explicit}} x granularity in {session, turn}, subset_size 0; the workflow passes --agent-memory-budget from the control row's configuration.budget, and for agent_memory_semantic reads that row's configuration and passes --agent-memory-semantic-retrieval required
environment.mem0_row_install: python -m pip install mem0ai==2.2.1 qdrant-client==1.17.0 sentence-transformers==5.2.3 torch==2.10.0 (the releases the accepted lane v1 Mem0 row resolved, run 37351804149); verify_install_posture() refuses any other mem0 release or an installed fastembed/spaCy extra
environment.embedder_weights: sentence-transformers/multi-qa-MiniLM-L6-cos-v1 at Hugging Face revision b207367332321f8e44f96e224ef15bc607f4dbf0, downloaded into HF_HOME at run time
environment.dataset_acquisition: curl of the frozen hub URL, sha256 verified against dataset.input_sha256 before the run
environment.preconditions: git rev-parse HEAD equals the workflow sha; agent-memory benchmark validate-lane passes; the lane status is frozen and the selected row is frozen; git hash-object of every reference/* path in harness.source_blobs equals the frozen blob
environment.semantic_row_install: agent_memory_semantic only: python -m pip install -e '.[semantic]' -r reference/requirements.txt -c reference/requirements-semantic.txt; the pinned MiniLM ONNX files are fetched by python -m agentmem_ref.runtime.representation_onnx fetch into AGENT_MEMORY_REPRESENTATION_DIR and verified by sha256 before the facade opens

artifact_requirements: the native report JSON with per-question rows (<granularity>-<backend>.json)
execution-identity.json (repository revision, lane id and digest, backend, plane, subset_size, input sha256, reference/* blobs, resolved package versions, Mem0 extras posture, workflow run id)
lane-validation.json as emitted by agent-memory benchmark validate-lane --json at execution
files.txt and sha256.txt inventories of the artifact
execution_identity_requirements: lane_digest_sha256 at execution == the digest of this file as committed
input.sha256 == dataset.input_sha256 and input.selection.question_ids_sha256 == the frozen selection digest
execution.external_backends.mem0_explicit.system_revision == the Mem0 tag commit and install_posture.mem0ai == 2.2.1 with both extras absent (Mem0 row)

execution.agent_memory_configuration == {temporal_metadata: none, ranking_variant: default, budget: 50, semantic_retrieval: off} (control, lexical and Mem0 rows) or the same with semantic_retrieval: required (agent_memory_semantic); the importer overlays the runner defaults with the declared keys of the row that runs the agent_memory backend

runtime_baseline_state in {PASS, TRANSITION} and declaration_blob == the control row's configuration.runtime_baseline_posture.declaration_blob (recorded by the workflow from scripts/check_runtime_baseline_equivalence.py and the register)
source_blobs == harness.source_blobs for every reference/* path

agent_memory_semantic: identity.backend == agent_memory_semantic and identity.runner_backend == agent_memory; execution.agent_memory_semantic_posture has status enabled, mode required, and representation_ref, representation_version, config_digest, dimensions, minimum_similarity and candidate_limit equal to the row's configuration.semantic_representation; every other row records no such posture

configuration.tokens: [A-Za-z0-9_]+ lowercased, tokens longer than one character
configuration.ranking: items with any query-token overlap, ordered by overlap count desc, Jaccard desc, item id asc; items with no overlap are not returned

notes: a profile-local baseline, not upstream's flat-bm25 or dense retrievers, and not a market-position claim; the no_memory floor is available from the runner but is not a lane row

adapter.revision_rule: git blob of the module at execution must equal harness.source_blobs[reference/longmemeval_mem0_explicit_bridge.py] = 08366b72ac0d76fdc0754a8182e3b6fd61cb1912; it imports its Mem0 configuration from reference/amb_mem0_explicit_bridge.py (blob ce41b1f5766b99cb968b798be3ad6d37c3283228); bridge_version 0.1.0 recorded in every report

configuration.inference: infer=False on every add; the constructed LLM is replaced by a fail-closed guard, so any inference call aborts the question as a runtime_error
configuration.llm_config: provider openai with an inert api_key used solely to satisfy Mem0's eager client construction; never a credential

vector_store.mode: local path, on_disk=true, fresh per run, one collection for the whole run

configuration.isolation: one Mem0 user_id namespace per retriever call (lme-<row>-<call>), i.e. per question and plane; search is filtered to that namespace
configuration.add: Memory.add([{'role': 'user', 'content': <item text>}], user_id=<namespace>, metadata={'doc_id': <item id>, 'source_date': <session date>, 'lme_bridge': '0.1.0'}, infer=False); a result without an ADD event is counted as an ingestion failure
configuration.search: Memory.search(question, top_k=50, filters={'user_id': <namespace>}); threshold 0.1 and rerank=false are Mem0 2.2.1 defaults, recorded not tuned
configuration.identity_mapping: metadata.doc_id read back from each result in Mem0's order; results without doc_id are counted as unmapped and dropped
configuration.content_rule: item text verbatim (session: user turns joined by one space; turn: one user turn), identical to the text the other rows receive; ids, dates and gold never enter memory text

optional_components.install: pip install mem0ai==2.2.1 (base package, no extras)
optional_components.fastembed_bm25_keyword_search: not installed; Mem0 logs 'BM25 keyword search disabled' and ranks by vector similarity only
optional_components.spacy_lemmatizer: not installed; Mem0 skips text lemmatization

notes: document_timestamp is unsupported for retrieval: the session date is stored as metadata only and Mem0 2.2.1 does not use it to rank
the lane v1 Mem0 row resolved these exact stack releases under the AMB harness lock; without a harness lock here they are pinned explicitly so the retrieval stack is identical across the two lanes
the smoke run on the synthetic fixture with the real 2.2.1 stack ingested at ~10 ms per item; the full turn plane (122,416 items) is expected to take well under the 180-minute job bound

deferred_lanes.reason: Mem0 reflective extraction through a frozen LLM identity is a Mem0+LLM composition; it needs provider-dependent credentials and a separately frozen answer-model identity, and must be frozen before any reflective score is seen

LongMemEval_M is a different frozen input (9d79e552…) with ~10x the haystack per question; freeze it separately after the S rows are accepted and the Mem0 row's runtime on the full S turn plane is known

findings: reference/run_longmemeval.py had its three backends hard-coded (RETRIEVERS) and imported the Agent Memory facade directly; lane v1 deferred this lane for that reason. The registration seam added for this freeze keeps the built-in backends untouched and records every external backend's identity in execution.external_backends.

the runner evaluates the same question once per plane; per-question isolation for Mem0 therefore has to be per (question, plane), which the bridge implements as one user_id namespace per retriever call rather than per question id.

Mem0 2.2.1's default search threshold (0.1) drops low-similarity memories, so a Mem0 ranking can be shorter than the corpus even with top_k=50; a shorter ranking scores as misses beyond its length, exactly as any other backend's.
the hub serves longmemeval_s_cleaned.json with an x-linked-etag equal to its sha256, which the digest check relies on only as corroboration; the runner's own byte digest remains the binding identity.

the control executes during a declared baseline transition: the workflow records the checker state, line and declaration blob, and the importer refuses a run whose state is not admitted by the posture or whose declaration blob differs from the one pinned here, so a declaration amended by a later tranche (docs/67 Step A.6) invalidates this lane rather than silently changing its control
change_rule: any change to the upstream revision, the fixture or its digest, the selection, the budget, the gold identity, the evaluator (including the runner blob), execution semantics, or a frozen row's source, adapter (including the bridge blobs), or configuration after a score has been observed requires a new lane_id; while no score exists, a re-freeze may update the bound blobs in place; this record is never edited in place once status leaves frozen
